stemMarkdown: Two runners start together from the same point on a circular track 1500 m long and run in opposite directions at 7.5 km/h and 2.5 km/h. After how many seconds do they meet for the first time? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions their speeds add: $2.7778$ m/s. Together they must cover one full lap, so they meet after $\dfrac{1500}{2.7778} = 540.0$ seconds.
